The Router correctly identified the failure of the 'Wide open sleeves' and 'Characteristic sleeve drape' checkpoints. The 'Voluminous cut' checkpoint was marked present, which is acceptable as the gown does obscure the body, even if the shape is wrong. The Router was not too lenient; in fact, it was appropriately critical given the visible fusion.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified the catastrophic 'fusion' artifact on the right sleeve (Severity 4.5) and the 'structural_collapse' at the hem (Severity 3.5). The 'texture_anomaly' on the left sleeve (Severity 2.0) is also valid, noting the unnatural stiffness. Additionally, the shadow cast by the figure on the right does not fully align with the light source direction implied by the background shadows, suggesting a lighting/grounding inconsistency. The severity of the sleeve fusion is correctly rated as near-catastrophic for this class.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails major structural checkpoints for the 'academic gown' class. Specifically, the defining feature of wide, flowing sleeves is destroyed by fusion on one side and unnatural rigidity on the other. The hemline fails to drape naturally to the ankles, breaking the rectangular silhouette requirement. While the classifier correctly identifies the class (likely due to the cap and stole), the visual conformance to the taxonomy is poor. Only 4 out of 9 checkpoints are met (Voluminous cut, Front closure, Formal attire, Matte fabric). The failure of functional components (sleeves) and geometry (silhouette) heavily penalizes the score.

The hemline exhibits structural collapse, merging with the ground plane (Severity 3.5). The left sleeve shows texture anomalies (plastic-like stiffness). The perceptual quality auditor found no global noise/blur, but this does not mitigate the local structural failures. The artifact score is low due to the prominence and severity of the sleeve fusion.
